cases.assertion: A root-authorized exact parent/edge/target/digest binding permits one bounded child or adapter execution.
A descriptor for another frozen edge fails before launch and writes no canonical record.
Parent Dispatch or Activation mismatch fails closed.
Procedure, policy, or request digest mismatch fails closed.
Missing root authorization evidence fails closed.
Canonical child count at or above the maximum rejects another launch.
A composed child cannot chain another composition relation.
Worker-originated child Dispatch or adapter launch is rejected.
Cancellation records deterministic terminal evidence and no success result.
Child failure is visible to the parent and cannot become success.
Unavailable bounded adapter yields blocked or partial evidence, not success.
Rejected composition preserves byte-identical canonical state.
